description: This file defines a PHP class 'InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams' which extends a base filter parameter class. It includes constants and methods for managing search filters related to interview attachments within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Represents search filter parameters for interview attachments, including sorting capabilities and interview ID filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with a default sort field.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Returns the interview ID used in filtering.

methods.name: setInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the interview ID for filtering.
